title: AAC Capability Contract 1
description: Defines the canonical AAC Capability Contract schema and its serialized data contract.

ResourceKey.description: Optional localization resource key for the human-readable text.

displayText.description: Defines the reusable display text structure used by this canonical schema.

AllOf.description: Lists the all of associated with this authorization requirement.

AnyOf.description: Lists the any of associated with this authorization requirement.

authorizationRequirement.description: Defines the reusable authorization requirement structure used by this canonical schema.

Id.description: Stable identifier of this schema ref.

schemaRef.description: Defines the reusable schema ref structure used by this canonical schema.

Capability.description: Identity and human-facing metadata of the capability contract.

GroupId.description: Identifier of the capability group containing this capability.

AuthorizationPermissions.description: Authorization permission definitions declared by this capability contract.

Id.description: Stable identifier of this authorization permission.

Name.description: Human-readable name of this authorization permission.

Description.description: Human-readable description of this authorization permission.

Metadata.description: Additional structured metadata associated with this authorization permission.

Operations.description: Operations declared by this capability contract or provider.

Authorization.description: Specifies the authorization for this operation.

SensitiveInputPaths.description: Lists the sensitive input paths associated with this operation.

SensitiveOutputPaths.description: Lists the sensitive output paths associated with this operation.

Metadata.description: Additional structured metadata associated with this operation.

Interactions.description: Interaction schemas declared for this capability operation.

Schema.description: Canonical schema reference used by this interaction.

Metadata.description: Additional structured metadata associated with this AAC capability contract.

BindingQualifiersSchema.description: Optional schema reference defining one provider BindingQualifierProfile for this exact capability-contract version. When present, every provider BindingQualifierProfiles item MUST validate against the referenced schema; consumers evaluate the normalized provider profiles through their technology-specific CapabilityProfileMatcherClassName during RESOLVE.
